patch.title: Research-payment rules still await legal alignment
patch.statusLabel: Recognised legal-alignment question · wider option announced
patch.statusDetail: AMF says wider joint payments are available, while national implementing measures are still needed
patch.summary: The regulator says firms can use the wider EU joint-payment option. The inspected statute and binding AMF research rules still express the earlier framework, leaving a recognised national legal-alignment question.
patch.nationalGap: L533-12-4-1 retains the capped statutory safe harbour, while AMF314-22/24/29 retain own-resource and research-account treatment, separate identification and related protections. AMF announces the new wider option but says national implementing measures remain necessary. Equivalent legal effect under other rules and interpretation has not been resolved.
patch.consequence: The inspected binding texts still express the earlier payment framework. AMF nevertheless says the wider joint-payment option is available, and existing inducement and research-account rules provide other lawful routes and client safeguards. The remaining concern is legal clarity; no payment restriction, refused contract or missing client protection has been established.
patch.caveat: The €1bn condition is part of a safe harbour, not a universal ban. AMF314-24 already allows research costs within transaction commissions under research-account safeguards. General inducement rules can also matter; independent advice and portfolio management have stricter benefit rules. The AMF thematic explanation is not an identified amendment to binding law. This lead does not allege that any particular payment is unlawful or that general client safeguards are absent.
patch.recognitionNote: The current AMF Listing Act explanation announces wider joint payments from6June2026 and expressly says national implementing measures are required. Government impact assessmentp118 supports legislative work in general, but itsp120 research description should not be relied on as an exact account of the final EU rule.
